verdict.rationale: A state business-registry service could plausibly publish a documented public API, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows only web portals, online filing forms, CCFS search, downloadable forms, live chat and in-person counters, with no documented public API for programmatic use. The DOR portal probe shows only a JavaScript app shell, which is not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
